title: Let a blocked agent ask the conductor, not the human
done_when: Shipped. ask_conductor lets a dispatched agent put a question against its task_id and wait for the answer; the task holds a distinct open 'blocked' status, and answer_question (conductor only) delivers the answer and sets it running again (src-tauri/src/mcp.rs: ask_pending, answer_pending, open_question). Exchanges are kept on the task, so an answer is not lost. Bounded at MAX_QUESTIONS_PER_TASK=5 and a 900s ask timeout that tells the agent to use its judgement rather than stall. No conductor or a halted workspace is an explicit stated fallback to the human, not a silent default. wait_for_tasks returns early on a blocked task so the conductor is not waiting on a pane that is waiting on it, which is the shared mechanism dq3s0j called for. 14 tests. Verified 2026-08-22: 137 pass, fmt and clippy clean.
